newsitem.title: USA: AM Int'l to terminate merger, sets dividend.
newsitem.headline: AM Int'l to terminate merger, sets dividend.

text.p: AM International Inc said Thursday it plans to terminate after April 30 a proposed merger with Pacholder Associates Inc, in which AM shareholders would have received $5 a share.
The company also said it will declare a special dividend of $2.00 a share in May.

The company said no agreement had been reached so far and it does not believe the merger will close. AM also announced it has terminated talks with another unidentified party that had expressed an interest in buying the company for $5 a share.

AM International will also pay a special dividend of $2.00 a share in May following the termination of the merger agreement. The company expects the dividend will be funded with cash and cash equivalents on hand.
AM International sells and services graphics arts equipment.
Its shares closed up 1/8 Thursday at 3-3/4.
